description: Interior view of five O'Keeffe paintings on a white gallery wall. Subjects include cow and horse skulls, New Mexico landscape, and a flower.
imageCaption: Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe 27 New Paintings, New Mexico, New York, and Lake George, Interior Gallery View, 1930. Gelatin silver print, 8 x 10 inches. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. [2006.6.1134b]
title: Georgia O'Keeffe: 33 New Paintings (New Mexico), An American Place
